description: Find the implicit interest rate in a truck lease-purchase, compare total paid with the cash price, and see how a maintenance escrow changes the picture. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

balloon.description: Balloon or buyout paid at the end (US dollars). Enter 0 if the truck is yours after the last weekly payment.

down.description: Down payment (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for down payment. Unknown is not the same as zero.

escrow.description: Required maintenance escrow per week (US dollars). Money held back each week for repairs under the lease.

escrowBack.description: Escrow expected back at the end (US dollars). Unspent escrow you expect returned. Repairs paid from escrow are not a finance cost if you would pay them anyway.

price.description: Cash price of the same truck (US dollars). What the truck would cost to buy outright today, from a dealer quote or listing.

weekly.description: Weekly lease payment (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for weekly lease payment. Unknown is not the same as zero.

weeks.description: Number of weekly payments (weeks). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for number of weekly payments. Unknown is not the same as zero.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_truck_lease_purchase_true_apr_check

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.

title: Truck lease-purchase true APR check
